deployment_scope: Controlled local, synthetic data, shared PostgreSQL/private filesystem

fixed_findings.description: Current Memory receipts alone did not preserve post-backup Agent operation keys; a restored target could treat an old keyed request as a new execution
fixed_findings.resolution: Refuse release when any current issued Agent key for restored owners lacks a matching restored Run ID/scope/fingerprint; do not reconstruct newer Agent history

risks.control: Periodic bounded primary cleanup, safe retry and OS-owned competition fence; actual native synthetic dump/restore and current-primary Memory/control/receipt reconciliation before target release
risks.remaining: Installed monitored scheduler/supervisor, encrypted daily copies/35-day rotation/separate key custody, independent exact-ID deletion/WAL history and production recovery serving barrier

risks.control: Owner-scoped exact challenge/receipt/key semantics retained; current consent and terminal receipts survive controlled restore; all data/delete gaps inventoried
risks.remaining: Account/Person/Relationship/Conversation/Agent history/imported dataset erasure APIs, production identity/revocation, client caches/log collectors/provider copies, durable pending reconciliation

limits: Synthetic restore requires complete intact current primary; no production disaster recovery release
Old backups retain private rows until future verified rotation; primary deletion is not all-copy erasure
OS unlink hangs require supervisor termination; no elapsed-time lock theft or abandoned writer
R-07 production ingress/TLS/pool/filesystem sizing and R-08 provider/analysis prerequisites remain
Historical Windows worker exit remains unconfirmed; failures must be retained
